title: Tooling: 1.48× faster SharedPointCircuit.__init__ merge construction with identical receipts
body:
## Change and scope

At base `0b1cccf86e2f5132ed286a26ef0a681a495740ea` (folded onto merged [CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds#1994](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1994) verify digests), `SharedPointCircuit.__init__` builds the common-point merge DAG by, for each of `h` commons, sorting the local active set, unpacking child mappings through a per-node generator, and looking up merge keys with repeated attribute access. Profiling on the historical full-size circuit (`h=46`) shows construction wall time dominated by that merge/lookup loop.

This PR pre-sorts `local.active` and `local.outputs` once, unpacks children directly, binds hot lists/dicts locally, and keeps the historical node-allocation order. Every structural field (`args`, `core`, `union`, `provenance`, `outputs`, `active`, `merged_additions`, `additions`) and every verify receipt (`circuit_sha256`, roles, flags) stays identical. The bit-compression certificate does not list `scripts/shared_point_circuit.py` in `source_sha256`. Production `verify` keeps #1994’s hand-rolled digests.

**Tooling improvement; no new kappa.** Selected frontier untouched.

## Result

On Linux / CPython 3.12.3 (Linux-6.12.94+-x86_64-with-glibc2.39), five alternating fresh-process pairs timing only `SharedPointCircuit(46)` construction (verify excluded from the timer; nested `ExclusionCircuit(45)` construction included) gave median wall time **0.649 → 0.438 seconds (1.48×)**. Timing is host-descriptive and is not a correctness gate. Every verify receipt and constructed DAG matches the baseline checker fieldwise.

Package: `research/shared-point-init/`.

## Validation

```sh
python3.12 -I -B research/shared-point-init/verify.py
python3.12 -I -O -B research/shared-point-init/verify.py
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/shared-point-init
python3.12 -I -B research/shared-point-init/benchmark.py --rounds 5
```

Expected:

```text
PASS_SHARED_POINT_INIT verify_cases=5 mutant=rejected certs=0 no_new_kappa
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/shared-point-init outcome=completed
PASS_IDENTICAL_SHARED_POINT_INIT_RECEIPTS
```

Default verify is read-only. Historical support checks use `assert` and are stripped under `-O`; structure equality and `circuit_sha256` identity remain the gates. Full `make verify`, selected cold replay, Lean, and multiplication-theorem obligations were not rerun for this isolated historical-checker change.

## Overlap and credit

Closest priors (different objects): [CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds#756](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/756), [CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds#1793](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1793), [CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds#1861](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1861), [CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds#1922](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1922), [CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds#1984](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1984), merged [CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds#1994](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1994) (verify digests on the same file; this only rewrites `__init__`), [CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds#2039](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2039) (partial-swap verify digests; its open construction question on the **producer fork** `__init__` remains a separate follow-up). No competing open PR on canonical merge-construction at refresh.

Douglas R. Colkitt authored the shared-point / exclusion circuits and bit-compression screens. Prepared by Wentao Li ([VictorLiwentao](https://github.com/VictorLiwentao), [@Is__Victor](https://x.com/Is__Victor)) with substantial AI assistance, under Apache-2.0.
